## Parental OpControl 0.17.16

- Devices and Remote now show a 40 px device icon (laptop for Windows and Linux, phone for Android), green when online and red when offline, with an OS label next to the name.
- The Devices page uses tidy cards: header with child, client, latest and update status; time zone and client language side by side; notice/offline checkboxes in a two-column grid; a “System resources” preview with CPU, RAM and storage gauges (coming soon); and the Message button at the bottom.
- Remote disables View screen / View camera for offline devices and explains why on hover.
- Device time zones are automatic by default: the card shows “Automatic · from device: …” and only an explicit choice overrides it. Windows ids are stored as IANA ids (for example US Mountain Standard Time → America/Phoenix).
- The dashboard family time zone is the explicit family setting when set; otherwise it follows the family device seen most recently. The family settings page shows which zone and device are in use.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
